label: Turn a content plan into LinkedIn, Facebook Page and Instagram posts with an AI agent and publish after approval
description: Twice a week, turns the next story from the content plan into a post per network and publishes it after the author approves it. Facebook and Instagram have no ByteChef component yet, so they go through the Meta Graph API.

parameters.systemPrompt: You run the social media for a book of short stories. From the content plan, take the first row whose status is not "published". Write one post per network in Croatian: LinkedIn (reflective, up to 1,200 characters, ends with a question), Facebook (warm, up to 600 characters) and Instagram (short caption with up to 5 hashtags). Every post links to https://REPLACE_WITH_SHOP_DOMAIN.

response.responseSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"rowNumber": {"type": "integer", "description": "Sheet row number of the chosen story"}, "linkedin": {"type": "string", "description": "LinkedIn post"}, "facebook": {"type": "string", "description": "Facebook post"}, "instagram": {"type": "string", "description": "Instagram caption"}, "imageUrl": {"type": "string", "description": "Public URL of the story illustration from the plan"}}, "required": ["rowNumber", "linkedin", "facebook", "instagram", "imageUrl"]}

stickyNotes.content:
## Setup

This template has not been run end to end yet. Before you run it:

1. Anthropic API key.
2. Google Sheets and Google Mail (Gmail) connections.
3. LinkedIn connection; replace REPLACE_WITH_LINKEDIN_PERSON_URN.
4. Facebook Pages connection; replace REPLACE_WITH_FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID.
5. Instagram connection to a professional account.
6. A content plan spreadsheet with a Plan sheet and status, linkedinPostUrn, facebookPostId and instagramMediaId columns; replace REPLACE_WITH_CONTENT_PLAN_SPREADSHEET_ID.
7. Replace REPLACE_WITH_AUTHOR_EMAIL and REPLACE_WITH_SHOP_DOMAIN.

The Facebook Pages and Instagram steps use the components those PRs add.
